summary.action_spectrum_source: Policy on Maximum Timer Interval and Exposure Schedule for Sunlamp Products; Appendix B melanogenesis action spectrum table

input_manifest.retention: CI artifact sunstack-data-<run_id> (90 days) + committed docs/data.json product; raw provider payloads are local-only and NOT in git

summary.note: Tier C derives band weights from the action spectrum itself (uniform intra-band Tier-C approximation). No hand tuning.

score_semantics.absolute: global physical melanogenic intensity (100*E_mel/E_mel_global_ref); not locally normalized
score_semantics.atmospheric: geometry-conditioned transmission percentile (conditional comparison, not causal isolation)
score_semantics.atmospheric_note: transmission percentile = conditional comparison vs history, not a direct aerosol measurement
score_semantics.confidence: calibrated reliability from expected error (heuristic-reliability-v1); higher bins mean lower realized error, never sunnier skies
score_semantics.local: serving-domain historical local seasonal percentile (rebuilt with v5 scores)
score_semantics.overall: absolute-dominant composite (70% worldwide strength + local rarity, air clarity, confidence; capped at strength +20 so context cannot lift weak radiation); interpretation only - ranking uses fixed-duration dose
score_semantics.sed: independent erythemal channel: integral(E_ery dt)/100; NEVER positively increases TanScore/Opportunity
score_semantics.strong_sun_probability: probability of useful sun (ensemble/DNI/GHI/cloud); product quantity, not confidence
score_semantics.tandose: model-defined action-spectrum-weighted cumulative delayed-melanogenesis exposure (melanogenic-effective J/m^2); NOT an internationally standardized dose
score_semantics.uva_uvb_dose: diagnostic physical broadband doses; NOT action-spectrum-weighted biological endpoints
score_semantics.uvi_note: Headline UVI is bias-corrected inverse-error weighted fusion over unique providers (drives SED only); TanScore/TanDose come from the UVA/UVB model, not from UVI
